title.zh: 卷三十九 本紀第三十九: 順帝二
title.raw: 卷三十九 本紀第三十九: 順帝二 Volume 39 Annals 39: Shundi 2

sentences.zh: 順帝二

translations.literal: Shundi 2
translations.idiomatic: Shundi 2

sentences.zh: 二年春正月壬戌，太陰犯右執法。

translations.literal: Second year, spring, first month, on renxu day, the moon transgressed the Right Enforcer.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, on the renxu day of the first month of spring, the moon transgressed the Right Enforcer.

sentences.zh: 甲子，太陰犯角宿。

translations.literal: On jiazi day, the moon transgressed the Horn mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day, the moon transgressed the Horn mansion.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，宿松縣地震，山裂。

translations.literal: On yichou day, Susong County suffered an earthquake; mountains split.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day, Susong County was struck by an earthquake and mountains split open.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，太陰犯房宿。

translations.literal: On dingmao day, the moon transgressed the Room mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day, the moon transgressed the Room mansion.

sentences.zh: 是月，置都水庸田使司於平江。

translations.literal: That month, the Directorate of Water Control and Government Granaries was established at Pingjiang.
translations.idiomatic: That month the Directorate of Water Control and Government Granaries was established at Pingjiang.

sentences.zh: 三月戊申，以阿裏海牙家藏書畫賜伯顏。

translations.literal: Third month, on wushen day, the paintings and calligraphy in Arighaiya's household collection were bestowed on Bayan.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day of the third month, the paintings and calligraphy from Arighaiya's household collection were bestowed on Bayan.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以按灰為大宗正府也可劄魯忽赤，總掌天下奸盜詐偽。

translations.literal: On jiayin day, Anqa was appointed yeke jarquchi of the Office of the Imperial Clan, with overall charge of fraud and theft throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day, Anqa was appointed chief jarquchi of the Office of the Imperial Clan, charged with overseeing fraud and theft throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，以累朝御服朱衣、七寶項牌賜伯顏。

translations.literal: On dingsi day, successive dynasties' imperial robes of vermilion and seven-jeweled neck plaques were bestowed on Bayan.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day, imperial robes of vermilion and seven-jeweled neck plaques from successive reigns were bestowed on Bayan.

sentences.zh: 庚申，日赤如赭，壬戌，復如之。

translations.literal: On gengshen day, the sun was red as ochre; on renxu day it was again so.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day the sun was red as ochre, and on the renxu day it was again so.

sentences.zh: 賜征東元帥府軍士冬衣及甲。

translations.literal: Winter clothing and armor were bestowed on the soldiers of the Eastern Campaign Marshalate.
translations.idiomatic: Winter clothing and armor were bestowed on the soldiers of the Eastern Campaign Marshalate.

sentences.zh: 諸軍討廣西徭，久無功，敕行省、行臺、廉訪司官共督之。

translations.literal: The various armies campaigning against the Yao in Guangxi had long achieved no success; an edict ordered officials of the Branch Secretariat, Branch Censorate, and surveillance commission jointly to supervise them.
translations.idiomatic: The armies campaigning against the Yao in Guangxi had long achieved no success. An edict ordered officials of the branch secretariat, branch censorate, and surveillance commission to supervise the campaign jointly.

sentences.zh: 順州民饑，以鈔四千錠賑之。

translations.literal: The people of Shun Prefecture were in famine; four thousand ingots of paper money were issued to relieve them.
translations.idiomatic: The people of Shun Prefecture were starving. Four thousand ingots of paper money were issued for relief.

sentences.zh: 夜，太陰犯心宿。

translations.literal: At night, the moon transgressed the Heart mansion.
translations.idiomatic: That night the moon transgressed the Heart mansion.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，日赤如赭。

translations.literal: On guihai day, the sun was red as ochre.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day the sun was red as ochre.

sentences.zh: 甲子，太陰犯箕宿。

translations.literal: On jiazi day, the moon transgressed the Winnowing Basket mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day, the moon transgressed the Winnowing Basket mansion.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，太陰犯南斗。

translations.literal: On yichou day, the moon transgressed the Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day, the moon transgressed the Southern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 賜宗王火兒灰母答裏鈔一千錠。

translations.literal: Prince Qorqas was granted one thousand ingots of paper money for his mother Dali.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Qorqas was granted one thousand ingots of paper money for his mother Dali.

sentences.zh: 以撒敦上都居第賜太保定住，仍敕有司籍撒敦家財。

translations.literal: Sadun's residence at Shangdu was bestowed on Dingzhu, and the authorities were further ordered to register Sadun's household property.
translations.idiomatic: Sadun's residence at Shangdu was bestowed on Dingzhu, and the authorities were further ordered to register Sadun's household property.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，復四川鹽井之禁。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day, the prohibition on Sichuan salt wells was restored.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day, the prohibition on Sichuan salt wells was restored.

sentences.zh: 以按答木兒家人田宅賜太保定住。

translations.literal: The fields and dwellings of Andamur's household were bestowed on Dingzhu.
translations.idiomatic: The fields and dwellings of Andamur's household were bestowed on Dingzhu.

sentences.zh: 以汪家奴為宣政院使，加金紫光祿大夫。

translations.literal: Wangjianu was appointed commissioner of the Bureau of Buddhist and Tibetan Affairs and promoted to Grand Master of Splendid Happiness with Golden Seal and Blue Ribbon.
translations.idiomatic: Wangjianu was appointed commissioner of the Bureau of Buddhist and Tibetan Affairs and promoted to Grand Master of Splendid Happiness with Golden Seal and Blue Ribbon.

sentences.zh: 造武宗、英宗、明宗三朝皇后玉冊、玉寶。

translations.literal: Jade registers and jade seals were made for the empresses of the Wuzong, Yingzong, and Mingzong reigns.
translations.idiomatic: Jade registers and jade seals were made for the empresses of the Wuzong, Yingzong, and Mingzong reigns.

sentences.zh: 是月，陜西暴風，旱，無麥。

translations.literal: That month, Shaanxi suffered violent winds and drought; there was no wheat.
translations.idiomatic: That month Shaanxi suffered violent winds and drought, and there was no wheat harvest.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁丑朔，日赤如赭。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, on the dingchou new moon, the sun was red as ochre.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou new moon of the fourth month of summer, the sun was red as ochre.

sentences.zh: 禁民間私造格例。

translations.literal: Private manufacture of legal precedents among the people was prohibited.
translations.idiomatic: The private manufacture of legal precedents among the people was prohibited.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，封駙馬孛羅帖木兒為毓德王。

translations.literal: On wuyin day, the imperial son-in-law Boluotiemuer was enfeoffed as Prince of Cultivated Virtue.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day, the imperial son-in-law Boluotiemuer was enfeoffed as Prince of Cultivated Virtue.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，太陰犯角宿。

translations.literal: On bingxu day, the moon transgressed the Horn mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day, the moon transgressed the Horn mansion.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，禁服麒麟、鸞鳳、白兔、靈芝、雙角五爪龍、八龍、九龍、萬壽、福壽字、赭黃等服。

translations.literal: On dinghai day, it was forbidden to wear garments bearing qilin, phoenixes, white rabbits, spirit fungus, double-horned five-clawed dragons, eight dragons, nine dragons, the characters for "ten thousand years of life" and "fortune and longevity," ochre-yellow, and the like.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day, it was forbidden to wear garments bearing qilin, phoenixes, white rabbits, spirit fungus, double-horned five-clawed dragons, eight dragons, nine dragons, the characters for "ten thousand years of life" and "fortune and longevity," ochre-yellow, and the like.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以知樞密院事帖木兒不華為中書平章政事，撒迪為御史大夫。

translations.literal: On gengyin day, Temür Buqa, who held the post of vice director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was appointed associate administrator of the Secretariat; Sadi was appointed censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day, Temür Buqa, vice director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was appointed associate administrator of the Secretariat, and Sadi was appointed censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 甲午，遣使以香、幣賜武當、龍虎二山。

translations.literal: On jiawu day, envoys were dispatched to bestow incense and silks on Mount Wudang and Mount Longhu.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day, envoys were dispatched to bestow incense and silks on Mount Wudang and Mount Longhu.

sentences.zh: 詔以太平路為郯王徹徹禿食邑；

translations.literal: An edict made Taiping Circuit the fief of Prince Chechetu of Tan.
translations.idiomatic: An edict made Taiping Circuit the fief of Prince Chechetu of Tan.

sentences.zh: 以集慶、廬州、饒州禿禿哈民戶賜伯顏，仍於句容縣設長官所領之。

translations.literal: The tutuqa households of Jiqing, Luzhou, and Raozhou were bestowed on Bayan, and a chief magistrate's office was established at Jurong County to administer them.
translations.idiomatic: The tutuqa households of Jiqing, Luzhou, and Raozhou were bestowed on Bayan, and a chief magistrate's office was established at Jurong County to administer them.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，車駕時巡上都。

translations.literal: On wuxu day, the imperial carriage traveled seasonally to Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day, the imperial carriage traveled seasonally to Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 拜中書左丞耿煥為侍御史，王懋德為中書左丞。

translations.literal: Geng Huan, left vice director of the Secretariat, was appointed investigating censor; Wang Maode was appointed left vice director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Geng Huan, left vice director of the Secretariat, was appointed investigating censor, and Wang Maode was appointed left vice director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 賜宗室灰裏王金一錠、鈔一千錠，毓德王孛羅帖木兒鈔三千錠，公主八八鈔二千錠。

translations.literal: Prince Huoli of the imperial clan was granted one ingot of gold and one thousand ingots of paper money; Prince of Cultivated Virtue Boluotiemuer was granted three thousand ingots; Princess Baba was granted two thousand ingots.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Huoli of the imperial clan was granted one ingot of gold and one thousand ingots of paper money; the Prince of Cultivated Virtue Boluotiemuer received three thousand ingots; Princess Baba received two thousand ingots.

sentences.zh: 五月丙午朔，黃河復於故道。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on the bingwu new moon, the Yellow River returned to its former course.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu new moon of the fifth month, the Yellow River returned to its former course.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，太陰犯靈臺。

translations.literal: On gengxu day, the moon transgressed the Heavenly Terrace.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day, the moon transgressed the Heavenly Terrace.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，南陽、鄧州大霖雨，自是日至於六月甲申，湍河、白河大溢，水為災。

translations.literal: On yimao day, Nanyang and Dengzhou suffered great torrential rains; from that day until jiashen day of the sixth month, the Tuan River and Bai River overflowed greatly and water became a disaster.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day, Nanyang and Dengzhou suffered torrential rains. From that day until the jiashen day of the sixth month, the Tuan and Bai rivers overflowed greatly and caused flooding.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，太白晝見，丁巳，亦如之。

translations.literal: On bingchen day, Venus was visible by day; on dingsi day it was again so.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day Venus was visible in daylight, and on the dingsi day it was again so.

sentences.zh: 壬申，秦州山崩。

translations.literal: On renshen day, mountains collapsed in Qin Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day, mountains collapsed in Qin Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 是月，婺州不雨，至於六月。

translations.literal: That month, Wuzhou had no rain until the sixth month.
translations.idiomatic: That month Wuzhou had no rain until the sixth month.

sentences.zh: 六月丁丑，禁諸王、駙馬從衛服只孫衣，系絳環。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on dingchou day, princes, imperial sons-in-law, and their guards were forbidden to wear zhisun garments fastened with crimson rings.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day of the sixth month, princes, imperial sons-in-law, and their guards were forbidden to wear zhisun garments fastened with crimson rings.

sentences.zh: 贈宗王忽都答兒為雲安王，謚忠武；

translations.literal: Prince Qutudar was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Yun'an, with the posthumous title Loyal and Martial;
translations.idiomatic: Prince Qutudar was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Yun'an, with the posthumous title Loyal and Martial;

sentences.zh: 羅羅歹為保寧王，謚昭勇。

translations.literal: Luoluodai was enfeoffed as Prince of Baoning, with the posthumous title Illustrious and Brave.
translations.idiomatic: Luoluodai was enfeoffed as Prince of Baoning, with the posthumous title Illustrious and Brave.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，命中書平章政事阿吉剌知經筵事。

translations.literal: On gengchen day, Associate Administrator Ajili was ordered to oversee the Classics Colloquium.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day, Associate Administrator Ajili was ordered to oversee the Classics Colloquium.

sentences.zh: 戊子，以鐵木兒補化為江浙行省左丞相。

translations.literal: On wuzi day, Temür Buqa was appointed left director of the Jiangzhe Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day, Temür Buqa was appointed left director of the Jiangzhe Branch Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 太白犯井宿。

translations.literal: Venus transgressed the Well mansion.
translations.idiomatic: Venus transgressed the Well mansion.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以汴梁、大名諸路脫別臺地土賜伯顏。

translations.literal: On xinmao day, the lands of the Tuobietai platform in Bianliang, Daming, and other circuits were bestowed on Bayan.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day, the lands of the Tuobietai platform in Bianliang, Daming, and other circuits were bestowed on Bayan.

sentences.zh: 禮部侍郎忽裏臺請復科舉取士之制，不聽。

translations.literal: Hulitai, vice minister of rites, requested restoration of the civil service examination system for selecting scholars; the request was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: Hulitai, vice minister of rites, requested restoration of the civil service examination system; the request was not granted.

sentences.zh: 庚子，涇水溢。

translations.literal: On gengzi day, the Jing River overflowed.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day, the Jing River overflowed.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，以鈔五千錠賜吳王搠失江。

translations.literal: On xinchou day, five thousand ingots of paper money were bestowed on Prince Wu, Toghto Jiang.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day, five thousand ingots of paper money were bestowed on Prince Wu, Toghto Jiang.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙午，詔以公主奴倫引者思之地五千頃賜伯顏。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on bingwu day, an edict bestowed on Bayan five thousand qing of land at Nulun Yinzhe'si belonging to the princess.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day of the seventh month of autumn, an edict bestowed on Bayan five thousand qing of land at Nulun Yinzhe'si belonging to the princess.

sentences.zh: 以衛輝路賜衛王寬徹哥為食邑。

translations.literal: Weihui Circuit was made the fief of Prince Wei, Kanchüke.
translations.idiomatic: Weihui Circuit was made the fief of Prince Wei, Kanchüke.

sentences.zh: 己酉，太白犯鬼宿。

translations.literal: On jiyou day, Venus transgressed the Ghost mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day, Venus transgressed the Ghost mansion.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以定住、鎖南參議中書省事。

translations.literal: On gengxu day, Dingzhu and Suonan were appointed to deliberate on Secretariat affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day, Dingzhu and Suonan were appointed to deliberate on Secretariat affairs.

sentences.zh: 壬子，發阿魯哈、不蘭奚駱駝一百一十上供太皇太后乘輿之用。

translations.literal: On renzi day, one hundred ten camels from Aruqa and Buranxi were dispatched as tribute for the empress dowager's carriage.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day, one hundred ten camels from Aruqa and Buranxi were dispatched as tribute for the empress dowager's carriage.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，太白犯熒惑。

translations.literal: On yimao day, Venus transgressed Mars.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day, Venus transgressed Mars.

sentences.zh: 庚申，禁隔越中書口傳敕旨，冒支錢糧。

translations.literal: On gengshen day, it was forbidden to bypass the Secretariat with orally transmitted edicts and to draw funds and grain improperly.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day, it was forbidden to bypass the Secretariat with orally transmitted edicts and to draw funds and grain improperly.

sentences.zh: 甲子，命有司以所籍撒敦寶器分賜伯顏及太保定住。

translations.literal: On jiazi day, the authorities were ordered to distribute the confiscated treasures of Sadun between Bayan and Dingzhu.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day, the authorities were ordered to distribute the confiscated treasures of Sadun between Bayan and Dingzhu.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，中書平章政事孛羅徙宅，賜金二錠、銀十錠。

translations.literal: On yichou day, Associate Administrator Boluo moved his residence and was granted two ingots of gold and ten ingots of silver.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day, Associate Administrator Boluo moved his residence and was granted two ingots of gold and ten ingots of silver.

sentences.zh: 庚午，敕賜上都孔子廟碑，載累朝尊崇之意。

translations.literal: On gengwu day, an edict bestowed a stele on the Confucian temple at Shangdu, recording the successive reigns' reverence.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day, an edict bestowed a stele on the Confucian temple at Shangdu, recording how successive reigns had honored Confucius.

sentences.zh: 省諸王、公主、駙馬從衛糧賜之數。

translations.literal: The quantities of grain bestowed to the guards of princes, princesses, and imperial sons-in-law were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: The quantities of grain bestowed to the guards of princes, princesses, and imperial sons-in-law were reduced.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，命宗王不蘭奚，駙馬月魯不花、帖古思、教化鎮薛連可、怯魯連之地，各賜鈔六百錠及銀牌遣之。

translations.literal: On guiyou day, Prince Buranxi, the imperial sons-in-law Yulubuhua, Tegüs, and Jiaohua were ordered to guard the lands of Xuelianke and Qielulian, each granted six hundred ingots of paper money and silver plaques and sent forth.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day, Prince Buranxi and the imperial sons-in-law Yulubuhua, Tegüs, and Jiaohua were ordered to guard the lands of Xuelianke and Qielulian. Each was granted six hundred ingots of paper money and a silver plaque and sent forth.

sentences.zh: 是月，黃州蝗，督民捕之，人日五斗。

translations.literal: That month, Huang Prefecture suffered locusts; the people were ordered to catch them at five dou per person per day.
translations.idiomatic: That month Huang Prefecture suffered locusts. The people were ordered to catch them at a rate of five dou per person per day.

sentences.zh: 以鈔二千錠賑新收阿速軍扈從車駕者，每戶鈔二錠，死者人一錠。

translations.literal: Two thousand ingots of paper money were issued to relieve the newly enrolled Asud guards accompanying the imperial carriage: two ingots per household, and one ingot per deceased person.
translations.idiomatic: Two thousand ingots of paper money were issued to relieve the newly enrolled Asud guards accompanying the imperial carriage: two ingots per household, and one ingot for each deceased person.

sentences.zh: 八月甲戌朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on the jiaxu new moon, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu new moon of the eighth month, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 高郵大雨雹。

translations.literal: Gaoyou suffered a great hailstorm.
translations.idiomatic: Gaoyou suffered a great hailstorm.

sentences.zh: 詔：「雲南、廣海、八番及甘肅、四川邊遠官死而不能歸葬者，有司給糧食舟車護送還鄉。

translations.literal: An edict said: "For officials in remote border posts of Yunnan, Guanghai, the Eight Circuits, Gansu, and Sichuan who die and cannot be returned for burial, the authorities shall provide grain, boats, and carts to escort them home.
translations.idiomatic: An edict declared: "For officials in remote border posts of Yunnan, Guanghai, the Eight Circuits, Gansu, and Sichuan who die and cannot be returned home for burial, the authorities shall provide grain, boats, and carts to escort them home.

sentences.zh: 去鄉遠者，加鈔二十錠；

translations.literal: For those far from home, twenty additional ingots of paper money were added;
translations.idiomatic: For those far from home, twenty additional ingots of paper money were added;

sentences.zh: 無親屬者，官為瘞之。

translations.literal: for those without kin, the government shall bury them.
translations.idiomatic: for those without kin, the government shall bury them.

sentences.zh: 」命威順王寬徹不花還鎮湖廣。

translations.literal: " Prince Weishun, Kanchübuqa, was ordered to return and guard Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: " Prince Weishun, Kanchübuqa, was ordered to return and guard Huguang.

sentences.zh: 先是，伯顏矯制召之至京，至是帝遣歸藩。

translations.literal: Earlier, Bayan had forged an edict summoning him to the capital; now the emperor sent him back to his fief.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Bayan had forged an edict summoning him to the capital; now the emperor sent him back to his fief.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，祭社稷。

translations.literal: On wuyin day, the altars of soil and grain were sacrificed to.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day, sacrifice was offered at the altars of soil and grain.

sentences.zh: 大都至通州霖雨，大水，敕軍人修道。

translations.literal: From Dadu to Tongzhou there was torrential rain and great flooding; soldiers were ordered to repair the roads.
translations.idiomatic: From Dadu to Tongzhou there was torrential rain and great flooding. Soldiers were ordered to repair the roads.

sentences.zh: 己卯，太陰犯心宿。

translations.literal: On jimao day, the moon transgressed the Heart mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day, the moon transgressed the Heart mansion.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，太陰犯箕宿。

translations.literal: On xinsi day, the moon transgressed the Winnowing Basket mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day, the moon transgressed the Winnowing Basket mansion.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以徽政院、中政院財賦府田租六萬三千三百石補本年海運未敷之數，令有司歸其直。

translations.literal: On xinmao day, sixty-three thousand three hundred shi of rent grain from the revenue estates of the Bureau of Palace Provisions and the Bureau of Imperial Household Revenue were used to make up the shortfall in that year's sea transport, and the authorities were ordered to repay its value.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day, sixty-three thousand three hundred shi of rent grain from the revenue estates of the Bureau of Palace Provisions and the Bureau of Imperial Household Revenue were used to make up the shortfall in that year's sea transport, and the authorities were ordered to repay its value.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，立屯衛於馬劄罕之地。

translations.literal: On renchen day, a garrison guard was established in the land of Majahan.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day, a garrison guard was established in the land of Majahan.

sentences.zh: 庚子，詔：「強盜皆死，盜牛馬者劓，盜驢騾者黥額，再犯劓，盜羊豕者墨項，再犯黥，三犯劓；

translations.literal: On gengzi day, an edict said: "All robbers shall be put to death. Those who steal cattle and horses shall have their noses cut off; those who steal donkeys and mules shall be tattooed on the forehead, and on a second offense their noses shall be cut off; those who steal sheep and pigs shall be inked on the neck, on a second offense tattooed, and on a third offense their noses shall be cut off;
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day, an edict declared: "All robbers shall be put to death. Those who steal cattle and horses shall have their noses cut off; those who steal donkeys and mules shall be tattooed on the forehead, and on a second offense their noses shall be cut off; those who steal sheep and pigs shall be inked on the neck, on a second offense tattooed, and on a third offense their noses shall be cut off;

sentences.zh: 劓後再犯者死。

translations.literal: those who offend again after having their noses cut off shall be put to death.
translations.idiomatic: those who offend again after having their noses cut off shall be put to death.

sentences.zh: 盜諸物者，照其數估價。

translations.literal: Those who steal other goods shall be assessed according to their number and estimated value.
translations.idiomatic: Those who steal other goods shall be assessed according to their number and estimated value.

sentences.zh: 省、院、臺、五府官三年一次審決。

translations.literal: Officials of the Secretariat, Censorate, surveillance institutions, and the Five Offices shall review and decide cases once every three years.
translations.idiomatic: Officials of the Secretariat, Censorate, surveillance institutions, and the Five Offices shall review and decide cases once every three years.

sentences.zh: 著為令。

translations.literal: This was established as a statute.
translations.idiomatic: This was established as a statute.

sentences.zh: 」辛丑，減馬湖路泥溪、平夷、蠻夷、夷都、沐川、雷坡六長官司，並為三。

translations.literal: " On xinchou day, the six chief-official offices of Nixi, Pingyi, Manyi, Yidu, Muchuan, and Leipo in Mahu Circuit were reduced and combined into three.
translations.idiomatic: " On the xinchou day, the six chief-official offices of Nixi, Pingyi, Manyi, Yidu, Muchuan, and Leipo in Mahu Circuit were reduced and combined into three.

sentences.zh: 九月庚戌，熒惑犯太微垣。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on gengxu day, Mars transgressed the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day of the ninth month, Mars transgressed the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，弛鞏昌總帥府漢人軍器之禁。

translations.literal: On guihai day, the prohibition on weapons for Han people in the Gongchang Marshalate was relaxed.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day, the prohibition on weapons for Han people in the Gongchang Marshalate was relaxed.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，車駕還自上都。

translations.literal: On wuchen day, the imperial carriage returned from Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day, the imperial carriage returned from Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 海運糧至京，遣官致祭天妃。

translations.literal: When the sea-transport grain reached the capital, officials were dispatched to offer sacrifice to the Celestial Consort.
translations.idiomatic: When the sea-transport grain reached the capital, officials were dispatched to offer sacrifice to the Celestial Consort.

sentences.zh: 是月，臺州路饑，發義倉、募富人出粟賑之。

translations.literal: That month, Taizhou Circuit was in famine; charity granaries were opened and the wealthy were enlisted to contribute grain for relief.
translations.idiomatic: That month Taizhou Circuit was in famine. Charity granaries were opened and the wealthy were enlisted to contribute grain for relief.

sentences.zh: 沅州路盧陽縣饑，賑糶米六千石。

translations.literal: Luyang County in Yuan Prefecture Circuit was in famine; six thousand shi of rice were issued for relief sale.
translations.idiomatic: Luyang County in Yuan Prefecture Circuit was starving. Six thousand shi of rice were issued for relief sale.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙子，熒惑犯左執法。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, on bingzi day, Mars transgressed the Left Enforcer.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day of the tenth month of winter, Mars transgressed the Left Enforcer.

sentences.zh: 己卯，享於太廟。

translations.literal: On jimao day, sacrifice was offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day, sacrifice was offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 丙申，命參知政事納麟監繪明宗皇帝御容。

translations.literal: On bingshen day, Vice Administrator Nalin was ordered to supervise the painting of Emperor Mingzong's imperial portrait.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day, Vice Administrator Nalin was ordered to supervise the painting of Emperor Mingzong's imperial portrait.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，太陰犯昴宿。

translations.literal: On dingyou day, the moon transgressed the Hairy Head mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day, the moon transgressed the Hairy Head mansion.

sentences.zh: 己亥，詔：「每日，右丞相伯顏，太保定住，中書平章政事孛羅、阿吉剌聚議於內廷。

translations.literal: On jihai day, an edict said: "Each day, Right Chancellor Bayan, Dingzhu, and Associate Administrators Boluo and Ajili shall deliberate in the inner court.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day, an edict declared: "Each day, Right Chancellor Bayan, Dingzhu, and Associate Administrators Boluo and Ajili shall deliberate in the inner court.

sentences.zh: 平章政事塔失海牙，右丞鞏卜班，參知政事納麟、許有壬等聚議於中書。

translations.literal: Associate Administrator Tashihaiya, Right Vice Director Gongbuban, and Vice Administrators Nalin, Xu Youren, and others shall deliberate at the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Associate Administrator Tashihaiya, Right Vice Director Gongbuban, and Vice Administrators Nalin, Xu Youren, and others shall deliberate at the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 」太陰犯進賢。

translations.literal: " The moon transgressed Advancing Worthies.
translations.idiomatic: " The moon transgressed Advancing Worthies.

sentences.zh: 是月，撫州、袁州、瑞州諸路饑，發米六萬石賑糶之。

translations.literal: That month, Fuzhou, Yuanzhou, and Ruizhou circuits were in famine; sixty thousand shi of rice were issued for relief sale.
translations.idiomatic: That month Fuzhou, Yuanzhou, and Ruizhou circuits were in famine. Sixty thousand shi of rice were issued for relief sale.

sentences.zh: 十一月己酉，太陰犯壘壁陣。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on jiyou day, the moon transgressed the Encampment and Wall formation.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day of the eleventh month, the moon transgressed the Encampment and Wall formation.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以那海為湖廣行省平章政事，討廣西叛徭。

translations.literal: On renzi day, Naihai was appointed associate administrator of the Huguang Branch Secretariat to suppress the rebellious Yao in Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day, Naihai was appointed associate administrator of the Huguang Branch Secretariat to suppress the rebellious Yao in Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 武宗、英宗、明宗三朝皇后升祔入廟，命官致祭。

translations.literal: The empresses of the Wuzong, Yingzong, and Mingzong reigns were elevated and enshrined in the temple; officials were ordered to offer sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: The empresses of the Wuzong, Yingzong, and Mingzong reigns were elevated and enshrined in the temple, and officials were ordered to offer sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，遣河南行省平章政事月珞普華於西番為僧。

translations.literal: On dingsi day, Yue Luopuhua, associate administrator of the Henan Branch Secretariat, was dispatched to the Western Regions as a monk.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day, Yue Luopuhua, associate administrator of the Henan Branch Secretariat, was dispatched to the Western Regions as a monk.

sentences.zh: 己未，太陰犯壘壁陣。

translations.literal: On jiwei day, the moon transgressed the Encampment and Wall formation.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day, the moon transgressed the Encampment and Wall formation.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，賜宣讓王帖木兒不花市宅錢四千錠，詔帖木兒不花王府官屬，朝賀班次列於有司之右。

translations.literal: On xinyou day, Prince of Proclaimed Forbearance Temür Buqa was granted four thousand ingots of paper money for purchasing a residence in the market, and an edict ordered that officials of Temür Buqa's princely household, when attending court congratulations, take their place in the ranks to the right of the regular offices.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day, the Prince of Proclaimed Forbearance Temür Buqa was granted four thousand ingots of paper money for purchasing a residence in the market. An edict ordered that officials of Temür Buqa's princely household, when attending court congratulations, take their place in the ranks to the right of the regular offices.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，命同知樞密院事者燕不花兼宮相都總管府達魯花赤，領隆鎮衛、左阿速衛諸軍。

translations.literal: On renxu day, Zheyanbuhua, vice director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was also appointed darughachi of the Palace and Capital Commissariat, commanding the Longzhen Guard, the Left Asud Guard, and other armies.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day, Zheyanbuhua, vice director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was also appointed darughachi of the Palace and Capital Commissariat, commanding the Longzhen Guard, the Left Asud Guard, and other armies.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，安置宗王不蘭奚於梧州。

translations.literal: On guihai day, Prince Buranxi was settled at Wuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day, Prince Buranxi was settled at Wuzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，太陰犯房宿。

translations.literal: On dingmao day, the moon transgressed the Room mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day, the moon transgressed the Room mansion.

sentences.zh: 辛未，禁彈弓、弩箭、袖箭。

translations.literal: On xinwei day, crossbows, arrows, and sleeve-bolts were prohibited.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day, crossbows, arrows, and sleeve-bolts were prohibited.

sentences.zh: 壬申，國公買住卒，賜鈔三百錠。

translations.literal: On renshen day, Duke Maizhu died and was granted three hundred ingots of paper money.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day, Duke Maizhu died and was granted three hundred ingots of paper money.

sentences.zh: 印造至元三年鈔本一百五十萬錠。

translations.literal: Paper money of the third year of Zhiyuan was printed in an issue of one million five hundred thousand ingots.
translations.idiomatic: Paper money of the third year of Zhiyuan was printed in an issue of one million five hundred thousand ingots.

sentences.zh: 是月，松江府上海縣饑，發義倉糧及募富人出粟賑之。

translations.literal: That month, Shanghai County in Songjiang Prefecture was in famine; charity-granary grain was issued and the wealthy were enlisted to contribute grain for relief.
translations.idiomatic: That month Shanghai County in Songjiang Prefecture was starving. Charity-granary grain was issued and the wealthy were enlisted to contribute grain for relief.

sentences.zh: 安豐路饑，賑糶麥四萬二千四百石。

translations.literal: Anfeng Circuit was in famine; forty-two thousand four hundred shi of wheat were issued for relief sale.
translations.idiomatic: Anfeng Circuit was starving. Forty-two thousand four hundred shi of wheat were issued for relief sale.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲戌，日赤如赭。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on jiaxu day, the sun was red as ochre.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day of the twelfth month, the sun was red as ochre.

sentences.zh: 丙子，命興元府鳳州留壩鎮及晉寧路遼山縣十八盤各立巡檢司。

translations.literal: On bingzi day, inspection offices were established at Liuba Town in Feng Prefecture of Xingyuan Circuit and at Shibapan in Liaoshan County of Jinning Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day, inspection offices were established at Liuba Town in Feng Prefecture of Xingyuan Circuit and at Shibapan in Liaoshan County of Jinning Circuit.

sentences.zh: 宗王也孫帖木兒進西馬三匹。

translations.literal: Prince Yesun Temür presented three Western horses.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Yesun Temür presented three Western horses.

sentences.zh: 賜文濟王蠻子金印、驛券及從衛者衣並糧五千石。

translations.literal: Prince of Literary Succor Manzi was granted a gold seal, post-station warrants, and clothing and grain for his guards totaling five thousand shi.
translations.idiomatic: The Prince of Literary Succor Manzi was granted a gold seal, post-station warrants, and clothing and grain for his guards totaling five thousand shi.

sentences.zh: 詔省、院、臺、翰林、集賢、奎章閣、太常禮儀院、禮部官定議寧宗皇帝尊謚、廟號。

translations.literal: An edict ordered officials of the Secretariat, Censorate, surveillance institutions, Hanlin Academy, Academy of Scholarly Glory, Pavilion of Literary Splendor, Court of Imperial Sacrifices, and Ministry of Rites to deliberate on the posthumous title and temple name of Emperor Ningzong.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered officials of the Secretariat, Censorate, surveillance institutions, Hanlin Academy, Academy of Scholarly Glory, Pavilion of Literary Splendor, Court of Imperial Sacrifices, and Ministry of Rites to deliberate on the posthumous title and temple name of Emperor Ningzong.

sentences.zh: 是月，江州諸縣饑，總管王大中貸富人粟以賑貧民，而免富人雜徭以為息，約年豐還之，民不病饑。

translations.literal: That month, the counties of Jiujiang Circuit were in famine. Prefect Wang Dazhong lent grain from the wealthy to relieve the poor, exempting the wealthy from miscellaneous corvée as interest, with repayment promised when the year was abundant; the people did not suffer from hunger.
translations.idiomatic: That month the counties of Jiujiang Circuit were starving. Prefect Wang Dazhong lent grain from the wealthy to relieve the poor, exempting the wealthy from miscellaneous corvée as interest and promising repayment when the year was abundant. The people did not suffer from hunger.

sentences.zh: 慶元慈溪縣饑，遣官賑之。

translations.literal: Cixi County in Qingyuan was in famine; officials were dispatched to relieve it.
translations.idiomatic: Cixi County in Qingyuan was starving, and officials were dispatched to relieve it.

sentences.zh: 是歲，詔整治驛傳。

translations.literal: That year, an edict ordered the rectification of courier stations.
translations.idiomatic: That year an edict ordered the rectification of courier stations.

sentences.zh: 以甘肅行省白城子屯田之地賜宗王喃忽裏。

translations.literal: The garrison-farmlands of Baichengzi in the Gansu Branch Secretariat were bestowed on Prince Nanhuli.
translations.idiomatic: The garrison-farmlands of Baichengzi in the Gansu Branch Secretariat were bestowed on Prince Nanhuli.

sentences.zh: 以燕鐵木兒居第賜灌頂國師曩哥星吉，號大覺海寺，塑千佛於其內。

translations.literal: Yan Temür's residence was bestowed on the State Preceptor Nanggasinggi, titled the Great Awakening Ocean Temple, with a thousand Buddhas sculpted within.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Temür's residence was bestowed on the State Preceptor Nanggasinggi as the Great Awakening Ocean Temple, with a thousand Buddhas sculpted within.

sentences.zh: 江浙旱，自春至於八月不雨，民大饑。

translations.literal: Jiangzhe suffered drought from spring until the eighth month without rain; the people were greatly afflicted by famine.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangzhe suffered drought from spring until the eighth month without rain, and the people were greatly afflicted by famine.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月癸卯，廣州增城縣民朱光卿反，其黨石昆山、鐘大明率眾從之，偽稱大金國，改元赤符。

translations.literal: Third year, spring, first month, on guimao day, Zhu Guangqing of Zengcheng County, Guangzhou, rebelled; his followers Shi Kunshan and Zhong Daming led the masses to join him, falsely calling their state Great Jin and changing the era name to Red Talisman.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, on the guimao day of the first month of spring, Zhu Guangqing of Zengcheng County, Guangzhou, rebelled. His followers Shi Kunshan and Zhong Daming led the masses to join him, falsely calling their state Great Jin and changing the era name to Red Talisman.

sentences.zh: 命指揮狗劄裏、江西行省左丞沙的討之。

translations.literal: Commander Qochili and Zuo Sha'di, left director of the Jiangxi Branch Secretariat, were ordered to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: Commander Qochili and Zuo Sha'di, left director of the Jiangxi Branch Secretariat, were ordered to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 戊申，大都南北兩城設賑糶米鋪二十處。

translations.literal: On wushen day, twenty relief-sale rice shops were established in the northern and southern wards of Dadu.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day, twenty relief-sale rice shops were established in the northern and southern wards of Dadu.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，升祔懿璘只班皇帝於廟，謚沖聖嗣孝皇帝，廟號寧宗。

translations.literal: On xinhai day, Emperor Yilinzhiban was elevated and enshrined in the temple, with the posthumous title Sagely Heir of Pure Succession and the temple name Ningzong.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day, Emperor Yilinzhiban was elevated and enshrined in the temple, with the posthumous title Sagely Heir of Pure Succession and the temple name Ningzong.

sentences.zh: 豫王阿剌忒納失裏買池州銅陵產銀地一所，請用私財煆煉，輸納官課，從之。

translations.literal: Prince of Yu Ala Temür purchased a tract of silver-producing land in Tongling, Chizhou, requesting to smelt it with private funds and pay official levies; the request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Yu Ala Temür purchased a tract of silver-producing land in Tongling, Chizhou, requesting to smelt it with private funds and pay official levies. The request was granted.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，立宣鎮侍衛屯田萬戶府於寧夏。

translations.literal: On guichou day, the Xuanzhen Guard Garrison Ten-Thousand Households was established at Ningxia.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day, the Xuanzhen Guard Garrison Ten-Thousand Households was established at Ningxia.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，月食。

translations.literal: On bingchen day, there was a lunar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day, there was a lunar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，日有交暈，左右珥上有白虹貫之。

translations.literal: On dingsi day, there was a solar halo with arcs on both sides and a white rainbow running through it.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day, there was a solar halo with arcs on both sides and a white rainbow running through it.

sentences.zh: 戊午，帝獵於柳林，凡三十五日。

translations.literal: On wuwu day, the emperor hunted at Willow Grove for thirty-five days in all.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day, the emperor hunted at Willow Grove for thirty-five days in all.

sentences.zh: 監察御史醜的、宋紹明進諫，帝嘉納之，賜金、幣。

translations.literal: Investigating censors Choude and Song Shaoming submitted remonstrance; the emperor praised and accepted it and bestowed gold and silks.
translations.idiomatic: Investigating censors Choude and Song Shaoming submitted remonstrance. The emperor praised and accepted it and bestowed gold and silks.

sentences.zh: 醜的等固辭，帝曰：「昔魏征進諫，唐太宗未嘗不賞，汝其受之。

translations.literal: Choude and others firmly declined; the emperor said: "In former times when Wei Zheng remonstrated, Emperor Taizong of Tang never failed to reward him. You too should accept it.
translations.idiomatic: Choude and the others firmly declined. The emperor said, "In former times when Wei Zheng remonstrated, Emperor Taizong of Tang never failed to reward him. You too should accept it."

sentences.zh: 」是月，臨江路新淦州、新喻州，瑞州民饑，賑糶米二萬石。

translations.literal: " That month, Xin'gan and Xinyu prefectures in Linjiang Circuit and the people of Ruizhou were in famine; twenty thousand shi of rice were issued for relief sale.
translations.idiomatic: " That month Xin'gan and Xinyu prefectures in Linjiang Circuit and the people of Ruizhou were starving. Twenty thousand shi of rice were issued for relief sale.

sentences.zh: 封晉郭璞為靈應侯。

translations.literal: Guo Pu of Jin was enfeoffed as Marquis of Spiritual Response.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Pu of Jin was enfeoffed as Marquis of Spiritual Response.

sentences.zh: 二月壬申朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Second month, on the renshen new moon, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen new moon of the second month, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 棒胡反於汝寧信陽州。

translations.literal: Bang Hu rebelled at Ruyang in Runing Prefecture of Runing Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Bang Hu rebelled at Ruyang in Runing Prefecture of Runing Circuit.

sentences.zh: 棒胡本陳州人，名閏兒，以燒香惑眾，妄造妖言作亂，破歸德府鹿邑，焚陳州，屯營於杏岡，命河南行省左丞慶童領兵討之。

translations.literal: Bang Hu was originally a man of Chen Prefecture, named Run'er; he deluded the masses with incense-burning and falsely created demonic words to raise rebellion. He seized Guide Prefecture's Luyi, burned Chen Prefecture, and encamped at Apricot Mound. Qing Tong, left director of the Henan Branch Secretariat, was ordered to lead troops to suppress him.
translations.idiomatic: Bang Hu was originally a man of Chen Prefecture named Run'er. He deluded the masses with incense-burning, fabricated demonic prophecies, and raised rebellion. He seized Luyi in Guide Prefecture, burned Chen Prefecture, and encamped at Apricot Mound. Qing Tong, left director of the Henan Branch Secretariat, was ordered to lead troops to suppress him.

sentences.zh: 紹興路大水。

translations.literal: Shaoxing Circuit suffered great flooding.
translations.idiomatic: Shaoxing Circuit suffered great flooding.

sentences.zh: 丙子，立船戶提舉司十處，提領二十處。

translations.literal: On bingzi day, ten boat-household superintendencies and twenty sub-superintendencies were established.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day, ten boat-household superintendencies and twenty sub-superintendencies were established.

sentences.zh: 定船戶科差，船一千料之上者，歲納鈔六錠，以下遞減。

translations.literal: Boat-household levies were fixed: for boats of one thousand piculs capacity and above, six ingots of paper money per year, with reductions for smaller boats.
translations.idiomatic: Boat-household levies were fixed: for boats of one thousand piculs capacity and above, six ingots of paper money per year, with reductions for smaller boats.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以上太皇太后玉冊、玉寶，恭謝太廟。

translations.literal: On renwu day, with the grand empress dowager's jade register and jade seal, grateful obeisance was offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day, with the grand empress dowager's jade register and jade seal, grateful obeisance was offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 甲申，定服色、器皿、輿馬之制。

translations.literal: On jiashen day, regulations for clothing colors, vessels, and carriages and horses were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day, regulations for clothing colors, vessels, and carriages and horses were fixed.

sentences.zh: 己丑，汝寧獻所獲棒胡彌勒佛、小旗、偽宣敕並紫金印、量天尺。

translations.literal: On jichou day, Runing presented the captured Maitreya Buddha, small banners, false edicts and commissions, and purple-gold seals, measuring-heaven rulers, and other objects of Bang Hu.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day, Runing presented the captured Maitreya Buddha, small banners, false edicts and commissions, purple-gold seals, measuring-heaven rulers, and other objects of Bang Hu.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，發鈔四十萬錠，賑江浙等處饑民四十萬戶，開所在山場、河泊之禁，聽民樵采。

translations.literal: On xinmao day, four hundred thousand ingots of paper money were issued to relieve four hundred thousand famine-stricken households in Jiangzhe and other regions; prohibitions on mountains and river fisheries in each locality were opened so the people might gather fuel and fish.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day, four hundred thousand ingots of paper money were issued to relieve four hundred thousand famine-stricken households in Jiangzhe and other regions. Prohibitions on mountains and river fisheries in each locality were opened so the people might gather fuel and fish.

sentences.zh: 廣西徭賊復反，命湖廣行省平章那海、江西行省平章禿兒迷失海牙總兵捕之。

translations.literal: The Yao bandits in Guangxi rebelled again; Naihai, associate administrator of the Huguang Branch Secretariat, and Tör Temür Haiya, associate administrator of the Jiangxi Branch Secretariat, were ordered to command troops jointly to capture them.
translations.idiomatic: The Yao bandits in Guangxi rebelled again. Naihai, associate administrator of the Huguang Branch Secretariat, and Tör Temür Haiya, associate administrator of the Jiangxi Branch Secretariat, were ordered to command troops jointly to capture them.

sentences.zh: 丙申，太保定住薨，給賜殯葬諸物。

translations.literal: On bingshen day, Dingzhu died; funerary objects were granted.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day, Dingzhu died, and funerary objects were granted.

sentences.zh: 庚子，中書參知政事納麟等請立采珠提舉司。

translations.literal: On gengzi day, Vice Administrators Nalin and others requested establishment of a pearl-collection superintendency.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day, Vice Administrators Nalin and others requested establishment of a pearl-collection superintendency.

sentences.zh: 先是，嘗立提舉司，泰定間以其煩擾罷去，至是納麟請復立之，且以采珠戶四萬賜伯顏。

translations.literal: Earlier a superintendency had been established but abolished in the Taiding reign because of its vexations; now Nalin requested its restoration and moreover that forty thousand pearl-collecting households be bestowed on Bayan.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier a superintendency had been established but abolished in the Taiding reign because of its vexations. Now Nalin requested its restoration and moreover that forty thousand pearl-collecting households be bestowed on Bayan.

sentences.zh: 是月，發義倉米賑蘄州及紹興饑民。

translations.literal: That month, charity-granary rice was issued to relieve the famine-stricken people of Qizhou and Shaoxing.
translations.idiomatic: That month charity-granary rice was issued to relieve the famine-stricken people of Qizhou and Shaoxing.

sentences.zh: 三月辛亥，太陰犯靈臺。

translations.literal: Third month, on xinhai day, the moon transgressed the Heavenly Terrace.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day of the third month, the moon transgressed the Heavenly Terrace.

sentences.zh: 發鈔一萬錠，賑大都寶坻饑民。

translations.literal: Ten thousand ingots of paper money were issued to relieve the famine-stricken people of Baodi in Dadu.
translations.idiomatic: Ten thousand ingots of paper money were issued to relieve the famine-stricken people of Baodi in Dadu.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以玉寶、玉冊立弘吉剌氏伯顏忽都為皇后，因雨輟賀。

translations.literal: On wuwu day, with jade seal and jade register, Boraghachi of the Onggirat clan was installed as empress; because of rain the congratulations were suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day, with jade seal and jade register, Boraghachi of the Onggirat clan was installed as empress. Because of rain the congratulations were suspended.

sentences.zh: 詔以完者帖木兒蘇州之田二百頃賜郯王徹徹禿。

translations.literal: An edict bestowed two hundred qing of land at Suzhou belonging to Wanzhe Temür on Prince Chechetu of Tan.
translations.idiomatic: An edict bestowed two hundred qing of land at Suzhou belonging to Wanzhe Temür on Prince Chechetu of Tan.

sentences.zh: 己未，大都饑，命於南北兩城賑糶糙米。

translations.literal: On jiwei day, Dadu was in famine; an order was issued to sell polished rice for relief in the northern and southern wards.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day, Dadu was starving. An order was issued to sell polished rice for relief in the northern and southern wards.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，加封晉周處為英義武惠正應王。

translations.literal: On guihai day, Zhou Chu of Jin was further enfeoffed as King of Heroic Righteousness, Martial Favor, and Correct Response.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day, Zhou Chu of Jin was further enfeoffed as King of Heroic Righteousness, Martial Favor, and Correct Response.

sentences.zh: 己丑，命宗王燕帖木兒為大宗正府劄魯忽赤。

translations.literal: On jichou day, Prince Yantu Temür was appointed jarquchi of the Office of the Imperial Clan.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day, Prince Yantu Temür was appointed jarquchi of the Office of the Imperial Clan.

sentences.zh: 是月，天雨線。

translations.literal: That month, thread fell from the sky.
translations.idiomatic: That month thread fell from the sky.

sentences.zh: 發義倉糧賑溧陽州饑民六萬九千二百人。

translations.literal: Charity-granary grain was issued to relieve sixty-nine thousand two hundred famine-stricken people in Liyang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Charity-granary grain was issued to relieve sixty-nine thousand two hundred famine-stricken people in Liyang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬申，遣使降香於龍虎、三茅、閣皂諸山。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, on renshen day, envoys were dispatched to offer incense at Mount Longhu, Mount Sanmao, Mount Gezao, and other mountains.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day of the fourth month of summer, envoys were dispatched to offer incense at Mount Longhu, Mount Sanmao, Mount Gezao, and other mountains.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，禁漢人、南人、高麗人不得執持軍器，凡有馬者拘入官。

translations.literal: On guiyou day, Han people, southerners, and Goryeans were forbidden to bear military weapons; all who had horses were confiscated by the government.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day, Han people, southerners, and Goryeans were forbidden to bear military weapons. All who had horses were confiscated by the government.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，有星孛於王良，至七月壬寅沒於貫索。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day, a broom star appeared at Wangliang; on renyin day of the seventh month it vanished at Guansuo.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day, a broom star appeared at Wangliang. On the renyin day of the seventh month it vanished at Guansuo.

sentences.zh: 皇后以受玉冊、玉寶，恭謝太廟。

translations.literal: Because the empress received the jade register and jade seal, grateful obeisance was offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: Because the empress received the jade register and jade seal, grateful obeisance was offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 命伯顏領宣鎮侍衛軍，賜鈔三千錠，建宣鎮侍衛府。

translations.literal: Bayan was ordered to command the Xuanzhen Guard; three thousand ingots of paper money were bestowed and the Xuanzhen Guard headquarters was established.
translations.idiomatic: Bayan was ordered to command the Xuanzhen Guard. Three thousand ingots of paper money were bestowed and the Xuanzhen Guard headquarters was established.

sentences.zh: 以太皇太后受冊、寶詔天下。

translations.literal: Because the grand empress dowager received the register and seal, an edict was proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: Because the grand empress dowager received the register and seal, an edict was proclaimed throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 己卯，車駕時巡上都。

translations.literal: On jimao day, the imperial carriage traveled seasonally to Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day, the imperial carriage traveled seasonally to Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 壬午，高麗王阿剌忒納失裏朝賀還國，賜金一錠、鈔二千錠，從官賜與有差。

translations.literal: On renwu day, the king of Goryeo Ala Temür came to court with congratulations and returned to his country; he was granted one ingot of gold and two thousand ingots of paper money, and his attendants were bestowed according to rank.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day, the king of Goryeo Ala Temür came to court with congratulations and returned to his country. He was granted one ingot of gold and two thousand ingots of paper money, and his attendants were bestowed according to rank.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，合州大足縣民韓法師反，自稱南朝趙王。

translations.literal: On xinmao day, Han Fashi of Dazu County in He Prefecture rebelled, calling himself King Zhao of the Southern Dynasty.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day, Han Fashi of Dazu County in He Prefecture rebelled, calling himself King Zhao of the Southern Dynasty.

sentences.zh: 太陰犯壘壁陣。

translations.literal: The moon transgressed the Encampment and Wall formation.
translations.idiomatic: The moon transgressed the Encampment and Wall formation.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，謚唐杜甫為文貞。

translations.literal: On dingyou day, Du Fu of Tang was given the posthumous title Literary and Upright.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day, Du Fu of Tang was given the posthumous title Literary and Upright.

sentences.zh: 己亥，惠州歸善縣民聶秀卿、譚景山等造軍器，拜戴甲為定光佛，與朱光卿相結為亂，命江西行省左丞沙的捕之。

translations.literal: On jihai day, Nie Xiuqing, Tan Jingshan, and others of Guishan County in Huizhou manufactured weapons, honored Dai Jia as the Buddha of Fixed Light, and joined with Zhu Guangqing in rebellion; Zuo Sha'di, left director of the Jiangxi Branch Secretariat, was ordered to capture them.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day, Nie Xiuqing, Tan Jingshan, and others of Guishan County in Huizhou manufactured weapons, honored Dai Jia as the Buddha of Fixed Light, and joined with Zhu Guangqing in rebellion. Zuo Sha'di, left director of the Jiangxi Branch Secretariat, was ordered to capture them.

sentences.zh: 庚子，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On gengzi day, Venus was visible by day.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day, Venus was visible in daylight.

sentences.zh: 是月，詔：「省、院、臺、部、宣慰司、廉訪司及部府幕官之長，並用蒙古、色目人。

translations.literal: That month, an edict said: "At the Secretariat, Censorate, surveillance institutions, ministries, branch secretariats, surveillance commissions, and chief officials of subordinate offices and prefectural staffs, Mongol and semuren are to be employed.
translations.idiomatic: That month an edict declared: "At the Secretariat, Censorate, surveillance institutions, ministries, branch secretariats, surveillance commissions, and chief officials of subordinate offices and prefectural staffs, Mongols and semuren are to be employed.

sentences.zh: 禁漢人、南人不得習學蒙古、色目文字。

translations.literal: Han people and southerners are forbidden to study Mongol and semuren script."
translations.idiomatic: Han people and southerners are forbidden to study Mongol and semuren script."

sentences.zh: 」以米八千石、鈔二千八百錠賑哈剌奴兒饑民。

translations.literal: Eight thousand shi of rice and two thousand eight hundred ingots of paper money were issued to relieve the famine-stricken people of Qarakhunur.
translations.idiomatic: Eight thousand shi of rice and two thousand eight hundred ingots of paper money were issued to relieve the famine-stricken people of Qarakhunur.

sentences.zh: 龍興路南昌、新建縣饑，太皇太后發徽政院糧三萬六千七百七十石賑糶之。

translations.literal: Nanchang and Xinjian counties in Longxing Circuit were in famine; the grand empress dowager issued thirty-six thousand seven hundred seventy shi of grain from the Bureau of Palace Provisions for relief sale.
translations.idiomatic: Nanchang and Xinjian counties in Longxing Circuit were starving. The grand empress dowager issued thirty-six thousand seven hundred seventy shi of grain from the Bureau of Palace Provisions for relief sale.

sentences.zh: 五月辛丑，民間訛言朝廷拘刷童男、童女，一時嫁娶殆盡。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on xinchou day, among the people a false rumor spread that the court was rounding up boys and girls; for a time marriage was rushed to completion almost entirely.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the xinchou day, a false rumor spread among the people that the court was rounding up boys and girls. For a time marriage was rushed to completion almost entirely.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，太白犯鬼宿。

translations.literal: On renyin day, Venus transgressed the Ghost mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day, Venus transgressed the Ghost mansion.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，給平伐、都雲定雲二處安撫司達魯花赤暗都剌等虎符。

translations.literal: On guimao day, tiger tallies were granted to Andusila and others, darughachi of the Pingfa and Duyun Dingyun pacification commissions.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day, tiger tallies were granted to Andusila and others, darughachi of the Pingfa and Duyun Dingyun pacification commissions.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以興州、松州民饑，禁上都、興和造酒。

translations.literal: On yisi day, because the people of Xing and Song prefectures were in famine, wine-making at Shangdu and Xinghe was prohibited.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day, because the people of Xing and Song prefectures were starving, wine-making at Shangdu and Xinghe was prohibited.

sentences.zh: 太陰犯軒轅。

translations.literal: The moon transgressed the Xuanyuan constellation.
translations.idiomatic: The moon transgressed the Xuanyuan constellation.

sentences.zh: 戊申，詔：「汝寧棒胡，廣東朱光卿、聶秀卿等，皆系漢人。

translations.literal: On wushen day, an edict said: "Bang Hu of Runing, Zhu Guangqing of Guangdong, Nie Xiuqing, and others are all Han people.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day, an edict declared: "Bang Hu of Runing, Zhu Guangqing of Guangdong, Nie Xiuqing, and others are all Han people.

sentences.zh: 漢人有官於省、臺、院及翰林、集賢者，可講求誅捕之法以聞。

translations.literal: For Han who hold office in the Secretariat, Censorate, surveillance institutions, Hanlin, and Academy of Scholarly Glory, methods of execution and capture may be discussed and reported."
translations.idiomatic: For Han who hold office in the Secretariat, Censorate, surveillance institutions, Hanlin, and Academy of Scholarly Glory, methods of execution and capture may be discussed and reported."

sentences.zh: 」太白晝見。

translations.literal: Venus was visible by day.
translations.idiomatic: Venus was visible in daylight.

sentences.zh: 壬子，太陰犯心宿。

translations.literal: On renzi day, the moon transgressed the Heart mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day, the moon transgressed the Heart mansion.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，詔哈八兒禿及禿堅帖木兒為太尉，各設僚屬幕官。

translations.literal: On jiayin day, an edict made Qaba'ertu and Tujian Temür grand marshals, each establishing subordinate staff and secretariat officials.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day, an edict made Qaba'ertu and Tujian Temür grand marshals, each establishing subordinate staff and secretariat officials.

sentences.zh: 西番賊起，殺鎮西王子黨兀班，立行宣政院，以也先帖木兒為院使，往討之。

translations.literal: Bandits rose in the Western Regions, killing Prince of Pacifying the West Dang'erban; a Branch Commission for Buddhist and Tibetan Affairs was established, with Esen Temür as commissioner, to campaign against them.
translations.idiomatic: Bandits rose in the Western Regions, killing the Prince of Pacifying the West Dang'erban. A Branch Commission for Buddhist and Tibetan Affairs was established, with Esen Temür as commissioner, to campaign against them.

sentences.zh: 戊午，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On wuwu day, Venus was visible by day.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day, Venus was visible in daylight.

sentences.zh: 己未，太陰犯壘壁陣。

translations.literal: On jiwei day, the moon transgressed the Encampment and Wall formation.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day, the moon transgressed the Encampment and Wall formation.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On xinyou day, Venus was visible by day.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day, Venus was visible in daylight.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，命四川行省參知政事舉理等捕反賊韓法師。

translations.literal: On renxu day, Jüri and others, vice administrators of the Sichuan Branch Secretariat, were ordered to capture the rebel Han Fashi.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day, Jüri and others, vice administrators of the Sichuan Branch Secretariat, were ordered to capture the rebel Han Fashi.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，彗星見於東北，大如天船星，色白，約長尺餘，彗指西南，至八月庚午始滅。

translations.literal: On dingmao day, a comet appeared in the northeast, as large as the Celestial Boat star, white in color, about a foot long, with its tail pointing southwest; it vanished on gengwu day of the eighth month.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day, a comet appeared in the northeast, as large as the Celestial Boat star, white in color, about a foot long, with its tail pointing southwest. It vanished on the gengwu day of the eighth month.

sentences.zh: 六月庚午，太白經天，辛未、甲戌，復如之。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on gengwu day, Venus crossed the sky; on xinwei and jiaxu days it was again so.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day of the sixth month, Venus crossed the sky. On the xinwei and jiaxu days it was again so.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，太白犯靈臺。

translations.literal: On yihai day, Venus transgressed the Heavenly Terrace.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day, Venus transgressed the Heavenly Terrace.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，贈丞相安童推忠佐運開國元勛、東平忠憲王，於所封城內建立祠廟，官為致祭。

translations.literal: On wuyin day, Chancellor Angge was posthumously enfeoffed as founding meritorious minister who supported loyalty and aided transport, King of Dongping, Loyal and Commiserating; a temple was established in his enfeoffed city and officials were ordered to offer sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day, Chancellor Angge was posthumously enfeoffed as founding meritorious minister who supported loyalty and aided transport, King of Dongping, Loyal and Commiserating. A temple was established in his enfeoffed city and officials were ordered to offer sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 己卯，太白經天。

translations.literal: On jimao day, Venus crossed the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day, Venus crossed the sky.

sentences.zh: 夜，太白犯太微垣。

translations.literal: At night, Venus transgressed the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: That night Venus transgressed the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，大霖雨，自是日至癸巳不止。

translations.literal: On xinsi day, great torrential rains fell and from that day until guisi did not cease.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day great torrential rains fell, and from that day until guisi they did not cease.

sentences.zh: 京師、河南、北水溢，御河、黃河、沁河、渾河水溢，沒人畜、廬舍甚眾。

translations.literal: The capital, Henan, and the northern regions overflowed with water; the Imperial River, Yellow River, Qin River, and Hun River overflowed, drowning many people, livestock, and dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: The capital, Henan, and the northern regions were inundated. The Imperial River, Yellow River, Qin River, and Hun River overflowed, drowning many people, livestock, and dwellings.

sentences.zh: 壬午，太白晝見，太陰犯斗宿。

translations.literal: On renwu day, Venus was visible by day; the moon transgressed the Dipper mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day, Venus was visible in daylight, and the moon transgressed the Dipper mansion.

sentences.zh: 癸未，設醮長春宮。

translations.literal: On guiwei day, a ritual was established at the Longevity Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day, a ritual was established at the Longevity Palace.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，太白犯太微垣。

translations.literal: On dinghai day, Venus transgressed the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day, Venus transgressed the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 戊子，加封文始尹真人為無上太初博文文始真君，徐甲為垂玄感聖慈化應禦真君，庚桑子洞靈感化超蹈混然真君，文子通玄光暢升元敏誘真君，列子沖虛至德遁世遊樂真君，莊子南華至極雄文弘道真君。

translations.literal: On wuzi day, Lord Yin of the Primordial Beginning of the Supreme Great Primordial Literary Beginning was further enfeoffed as True Lord; Xu Jia as True Lord of Sagely Transformation and Responsive Oversight; Gengsangzi as True Lord of Cave Spirit, Transformative Influence, and Transcendent Leap; Wenzi as True Lord of Penetrating Mystery, Radiant Expansion, and Elevated Origin; Liezi as True Lord of Empty Transcendence, Supreme Virtue, Worldly Withdrawal, and Joyful Roaming; Zhuangzi as True Lord of Southern Florescence, Supreme Pole, Heroic Literature, and Expansive Way.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day, Lord Yin of the Primordial Beginning of the Supreme Great Primordial Literary Beginning was further enfeoffed as True Lord; Xu Jia as True Lord of Sagely Transformation and Responsive Oversight; Gengsangzi as True Lord of Cave Spirit, Transformative Influence, and Transcendent Leap; Wenzi as True Lord of Penetrating Mystery, Radiant Expansion, and Elevated Origin; Liezi as True Lord of Empty Transcendence, Supreme Virtue, Worldly Withdrawal, and Joyful Roaming; Zhuangzi as True Lord of Southern Florescence, Supreme Pole, Heroic Literature, and Expansive Way.

sentences.zh: 己丑，太白晝見，庚寅，復如之，至七月辛酉方息。

translations.literal: On jichou day, Venus was visible by day; on gengyin day it was again so, until it ceased on xinyou day of the seventh month.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day Venus was visible in daylight, and on the gengyin day it was again so, until it ceased on the xinyou day of the seventh month.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，彰德大水，深一丈。

translations.literal: On renchen day, Zhangde suffered great flooding one zhang deep.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day, Zhangde suffered flooding one zhang deep.

sentences.zh: 立高密縣濰川鄉景芝社巡檢司。

translations.literal: An inspection office was established at Jingzhi community in Weichuan township, Gaomi County.
translations.idiomatic: An inspection office was established at Jingzhi community in Weichuan township, Gaomi County.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己亥，漳河泛溢至廣平城下。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on jihai day, the Zhang River flooded up to the foot of Guangping city.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day of the seventh month of autumn, the Zhang River flooded up to the foot of Guangping city.

sentences.zh: 賜鞏卜班西平王印。

translations.literal: The seal of King of Xiping was bestowed on Gongbuban.
translations.idiomatic: The seal of King of Xiping was bestowed on Gongbuban.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，車駕出獵。

translations.literal: On guimao day, the imperial carriage went out hunting.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day, the imperial carriage went out hunting.

sentences.zh: 太白經天。

translations.literal: Venus crossed the sky.
translations.idiomatic: Venus crossed the sky.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，復如之。

translations.literal: On yisi day, it was again so.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day, it was again so.

sentences.zh: 丙午，車駕幸失剌斡耳朵。

translations.literal: On bingwu day, the imperial carriage visited the Shilatu ordu.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day, the imperial carriage visited the Shilatu ordu.

sentences.zh: 太白復經天。

translations.literal: Venus again crossed the sky.
translations.idiomatic: Venus again crossed the sky.

sentences.zh: 丁未，車駕幸龍岡，灑馬乳以祭。

translations.literal: On dingwei day, the imperial carriage visited Longgang and sprinkled mare's milk as offering.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day, the imperial carriage visited Longgang and sprinkled mare's milk as offering.

sentences.zh: 戊申，召朵兒只國王入朝。

translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day of the third month, Saturn retreated and transgressed Eastern Suburb.

translations.idiomatic: Bang Hu of Henan was escorted to the capital and executed.

translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day, near dusk the imperial carriage reached Balitang. Hail fell as large as fists, in shapes of small children, rings, lions, elephants, tortoises, and eggs.

translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day of the fifth month, inspection offices were established at Mount Wutai and other places.

translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day, the Liang-Huai garrison hunt and capture chief command was promoted to the third rank.

translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Biebughua, associate administrator of the Jiangzhe Branch Secretariat, to command armies of Zhe, Min, Jiangxi, and Guangdong to suppress them.

translations.literal: Earlier, when Shizu had pacified Burma, because it lay at the extreme border of Yunnan, its chieftain was made commander and ordered to present tribute once every three years; now tribute came, and therefore government offices were established.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，以宣徽使別兒怯不花為御史大夫。

sentences.zh: 癸卯，太白經天，己酉，復如之。
